$comment: Machine-checkable security claims for HopeCoin. Every trust claim made in TOKEN_LAUNCH_STRATEGY.md and the contract natspec must appear here, mapped to executable evidence. Run `npm run verify` — it fails if any claim's evidence is missing, stale, or failing. Do not edit a claim without editing the code/tests that back it, and vice versa.

claims.statement: Total supply is exactly 250,000,000 HOPE, minted once at deployment to the deployer.

evidence.title: mints the full fixed supply to the deployer

claims.statement: No code path can ever increase or decrease the supply: there is no mint, burn, or rebase function. The 2% fee moves balance to the treasury; it never destroys it.
claims.source: HopeCoin.sol natspec; TOKEN_LAUNCH_STRATEGY.md § Launch Sequence step 1

claims.statement: Transfers can never be paused or frozen.
No address can be blacklisted or blocked from transferring.
claims.source: HopeCoin.sol natspec; TOKEN_LAUNCH_STRATEGY.md § Launch Sequence step 1

claims.statement: Every transfer sends exactly 2% (rounded down) to the treasury address fixed at deployment and the remainder to the recipient. The fee rate is a constant and the treasury is immutable: no function exists that can change either, raise the fee, or redirect it.

evidence.title: takes a fixed 2% fee to the treasury on every transfer

claims.notes: The HopeCoinHandler additionally asserts the exact 98/2 split inside every fuzzed transfer/transferFrom sequence, including self-transfers (which cost exactly the fee) and transfers to the treasury (which net the full amount).

claims.statement: Ownership grants no power over the token: the only state-changing functions are the standard ERC-20 surface plus the two Ownable handover functions, none of which touch balances, supply, the fee rate, or the treasury address.
renounceOwnership() sets the owner to the zero address, permanently and verifiably on-chain.

evidence.title: renounces ownership to the zero address

claims.statement: A transfer exceeding the sender's balance always reverts.

evidence.title: reverts when transferring more than the sender's balance
